source: City of Laguna Beach Building Division handout, "Building Submittal Requirements Prior to Building Permit Issuance" (current as of September 2026). "When it applies" is the City permit-technician criterion for each handout row.
note: These items come after Building plan check approval and before the permit issues. They are not part of the application completeness check. Items marked with * on the handout depend on the City record for the parcel.

items.handout_label: Planning Division Approval
items.when_it_applies: FOR ALL EXTERIOR WORK, ADDITIONS, NEW CONSTRUCTION, COMMERCIAL

items.handout_label: Fire Department Approval
items.when_it_applies: COMMERCIAL & MULTI-FAMILY: FIRE SPRINKLERS, FIRE ALARM, FIRE MONITORING, ADDITIONS, CELL SITES WITH BATTERY, COMMERCIAL OR MULTIFAMILY ENERGY SOTRAGE SYSTEMS (ESS)

items.handout_label: Public Works Department Approval (submit separate set of plans)
items.when_it_applies: R.O.W. ONLY

items.handout_label: Water Quality Management Plan Approval (submit separate set of plans)
items.when_it_applies: NEW CONSTRUCTION, LANDSCAPE, HARDSCAPE, T.I.s with work done to kitchen

items.handout_label: Health Department Approval Letter (submit to Orange County Environmental Health)
items.when_it_applies: FOOD ESTABLISHMENTS

items.handout_label: *Unpermitted work cleared or included in current submittal
items.when_it_applies: IF PARCEL MANAGER SHOWS OPEN CODE CASES RELATED TO BUILDING

items.handout_label: *Expired permits cleared or included in current submittal
items.when_it_applies: IF PARCEL MANAGER SHOWS EXPIRED PERMITS

items.handout_label: Architect or Designer signature on each page of plans
Engineer signature on each applicable page of plans
Geotechnical Engineer signature on grading and foundation plans
items.when_it_applies: ONLY WHEN SCOPE REQUIRES A GEOTECHNICAL REPORT (SOILS)

items.handout_label: Geotechnical Soils Report approved by the City's consultant (3rd party review)
items.when_it_applies: TBD BY PLANS EXAMINER

items.handout_label: Record of Survey
items.when_it_applies: IMPROVEMENT WITHIN 3' OF PL, ALL NEW CONSTRUCTION

items.handout_label: Construction Staging Plan and Affidavit (includes neighbor notification process)
items.when_it_applies: NEW CONSTRUCTION (ALWAYS); SOME LARGE ADDITIONS (TBD BY PLANS EXAMINER)

items.handout_label: Assessor set of plans (old submittal red line set accepted)
items.when_it_applies: ONLY APPLIES TO PAPER SUBMITTALS

items.handout_label: SCAQMD Demolition Notification (submit email receipt of 1403 notification)
items.when_it_applies: DEMOLITIONS, REMODELS (WE KEEP COPY OF 1403 NOTIFICATION)

items.handout_label: SCAQMD Asbestos Notification (submit email receipt of 1403 notification)
items.when_it_applies: DEMOLITIONS, REMODELS (WE KEEP COPY OF 1403 NOTIFICATION)

items.handout_label: Structure Demolition Only (gas meter removed)
items.when_it_applies: FOR SCOPES THAT INDLUDE DEMO OF BUILDING (LIKE A SFR): NOTIFICATION FROM UTILITY COMPANIES THAT METERS WERE REMOVED

items.handout_label: Structure Demolition Only (electric meter removed)
items.when_it_applies: FOR SCOPES THAT INDLUDE DEMO OF BUILDING (LIKE A SFR): NOTIFICATION FROM UTILITY COMPANIES THAT METERS WERE REMOVED

items.handout_label: Water Quality "Forward Lateral" (submit sewer video and payment to the Water Quality Department and provide email confirmation of receipt)
items.when_it_applies: RES & COMM. VALUATION OVER $100K - Scope must include NEW plumbing per City staff and City building staff. ***SOUTH LAGUNA EXEMPT (5 DIGIT ADDRESSES)*** POOLS ARE EXEMPT***

items.handout_label: Schedule Pre-Grade Meeting
items.when_it_applies: NEW CONSTRUCTION (TO BE SCHEDULED AT ISSUANCE)

items.handout_label: Schedule Pre-Construction Meeting
items.when_it_applies: NEW CONSTRUCTION (TO BE SCHEDULED AT ISSUANCE)

items.handout_label: Laguna Beach Unified School District School Fee Receipt
items.when_it_applies: ALL NEW CONSTRUCTION(NEW SFR, NEW COMM BLDG, ETC); ADDITIONS OVER 500 SF; ADUs OVER 750 SF

items.handout_label: Mechanical, electrical, plumbing (separate counts for project for fee calculation purposes)
items.when_it_applies: ADDITIONS, REMODELS, NEW CONSTRUCTION, T.I.s

items.handout_label: City Business License Required (general contractor and all subcontractors on the project) *Must be documented on City form and submitted to receive Final Inspection*
items.when_it_applies: REQUIRED FROM ALL CONTRACTORS

items.handout_label: Green Halo Program sign up (Public Works Construction & Demolition Recycling Waste Management Plan) *separate check required
items.when_it_applies: ALL NEW CONSTRUCTIONS, ADDITIONS, REMODELS, REROOFS (EXCEPT WHEN FLAT ROOFS) ***ALL OTHER SCOPES, TBD BY CITY STAFF IN PW***

items.handout_label: Code Enforcement Citations Paid *submit copies of receipt
items.when_it_applies: IF PARCEL MANAGER SHOWS OPEN CODE CASES RELATED TO BUILDING

items.handout_label: Road Development Fees: CARITS and Moulton Parkway
items.when_it_applies: NEW CONSTRUCTION & ADDITIONS OVER 500 SF; ADUs OVER 750 SF. Check address on OC Road Fees Map to determine if job site is in the CARITS or Moulton fee area. NON-PROFITS ARE EXEMPT (only applies if they are exempt from property taxes)
